I am in Quzhou County in Hebei, and at my age I will keep to a simple, familiar pattern that I know I can manage well. I will mainly follow the local wheat-maize rotation, because that fits the climate, the land, and the way I already work. Wheat gives me a steady winter crop, and summer maize makes full use of the rainy season. I do not want a complicated mix of many crops, because that adds labor, timing pressure, and risk. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it clearly helps yield and standability, and I will keep fertilizer and irrigation at moderate levels so I control cost while still aiming for a reliable harvest. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and faster for me than deep ploughing in most cases. I will spray only as needed but I will still plan for basic disease, weed, and insect control, because missing the right window can reduce yield quickly. My goal is not to chase the highest possible output, but to get a stable harvest with work I can realistically finish on time.
